            config_section = build_config_section(config['config'], 0, true, base_indent)
          elsif shape == :system_only

          elsif shape == :config_only
            config_section = build_config_section(config['config'], 0, true, base_indent)

        def build_config_section(config, indent, root, base_indent)
          body = new_section_body(indent, root)
          config.each do |entry|
            label_conf = entry.delete('label')
            if label_conf
              body.add_section(build_label_section(label_conf, indent, base_indent))
            end
            source_conf = entry.delete('source')
            if source_conf
              body.add_section(build_source_section(source_conf, indent, base_indent))
            end
            filter_conf = entry.delete('filter')
            if filter_conf
              body.add_section(build_filter_section(filter_conf, indent, base_indent))
            end
            match_conf = entry.delete('match')
            if match_conf
              body.add_section(build_match_section(match_conf, indent, base_indent))
            end
            worker_conf = entry.delete('worker')
            if worker_conf
              body.add_section(build_worker_section(worker_conf, indent, base_indent))
            end
            build_included_sections(entry, body, indent, base_indent)

        def build_included_sections(config, body, indent, base_indent)
          config.each_entry do |entry|
            key = included_entry_key(entry)
            nested = included_entry_body(entry, key)
            section = dispatch_included_section(key, nested, indent, base_indent)
            if section
              body.add_section(section)

          body

        def dispatch_included_section(key, nested, indent, base_indent)
          kind = classify_section_name(key)
          recognized = known_root_section?(key)
          if kind == :label && recognized
            build_label_section(nested, indent, base_indent)
          elsif kind == :worker && recognized
            build_worker_section(nested, indent, base_indent)
          elsif kind == :source && recognized
            build_source_section(nested, indent, base_indent)
          elsif kind == :filter && recognized
            build_filter_section(nested, indent, base_indent)
          elsif kind == :match && recognized
            build_match_section(nested, indent, base_indent)
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def build_named_section(name, config, indent, arg, base_indent)
          body = SectionBodyBuilder.new(child_indent(indent, base_indent))
          apply_type_directive(body, config)

          apply_id_directive(body, config)
          each_section_parameter(config).each do |key, val, _kind, _directive, _value_kind|
            emit_section_entry(body, key, val, indent, base_indent)

          SectionBuilder.new(name, body, indent, arg)

            attrs = attributes_from_rows(rows)
